description: Read constituent accounts, donations, memberships, campaigns, and events.

neon_crm_new_campaign_trigger.description: Runs for each new campaign in Neon CRM. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.record: object with the fields code, id, name, status, isDefault

output.record: object with the fields accountId, firstName, lastName, companyName, email, userType

neon_crm_new_event_trigger.description: Runs for each new event in Neon CRM. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 4,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
